one_line_description.value: Twenty is a CRM platform that gives technical teams building blocks for a customizable CRM.
one_line_description.quote: Twenty gives technical teams the building blocks for a custom CRM that meets complex business needs and quickly adapts as the business evolves.

has_public_api.quote: REST and GraphQL APIs generated from your workspace schema.

api_type.quote: Both are available as REST and GraphQL.

api_breadth.value: REST + GraphQL, schema-per-tenant; full read-write CRUD on records plus metadata/schema API; batch up to 60 records per request
api_breadth.quote: CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities, your custom objects. Query, filter, traverse relations.

docs_url.quote: There is no static API reference for Twenty. Each workspace has its own schema

auth_methods.quote: | Internal scripts, automation | API Key | | External app acting on behalf of a user | OAuth — Authorization Code |

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Request scopes as a space-separated string: `scope=api profile`

access_model.quote: Host Twenty on your own infrastructure at no cost:

access_notes.value: No application or sales gate for development: API keys are generated self-serve in Settings → Developers → API (scoped to a role), OAuth clients register via /oauth/register, self-hosting is free under the Free plan, and cloud starts with a free trial. Premium features (custom roles, row-level permissions, SSO, audit logs) require the Organization plan. The hosted MCP server endpoint is per-workspace (https://{your-workspace-url}/mcp).
access_notes.quote: Create an API key in Settings → Developers → API → + Create key. Copy it immediately — it's shown once.

official_mcp_server.quote: Use your workspace URL (the URL you use to access Twenty) as the MCP endpoint.

rate_limits.value: 100 requests per minute; batch size 60 records per call
rate_limits.quote: | Requests | 100 per minute | | Batch size | 60 records per call |

webhooks.quote: Twenty sends an HTTP POST to your URL whenever a record is created, updated, or deleted. All object types are covered, including custom objects.

sdk_languages.quote: Declare objects, server-side functions, React components and AI agents in plain TypeScript with the `twenty-sdk`, see each change sync to a local server as you save, and ship with the CLI.

verdict_reason: Twenty publishes an official REST + GraphQL API with full read-write CRUD, a metadata API, batch operations, webhooks, and documented OAuth 2.0 plus API-key auth. Credentials are self-serve: API keys are created directly in Settings → Developers → API, and self-hosting is free with a no-credit-card cloud trial. Rate limits (100 req/min) and a TypeScript SDK are documented, and a native MCP server ships with workspaces.
open_questions: No API versioning scheme or deprecation/sunset policy was found in the evidence bundle (the versioning search returned only the API page and terms of service); confirm whether Twenty versions its REST/GraphQL surface or follows a rolling-release model.

The API is described as both REST and GraphQL; api_type was recorded as REST per the single-primary-type field, but GraphQL is a first-class alternative (batch upserts, relation traversal in one query).

No dedicated sandbox/test tenant is documented — only Cloud and Self-Hosted base URLs plus a local dev environment (`twenty local start`); confirm whether a separate staging/sandbox workspace is officially supported.
No credible community/third-party MCP servers appeared in the evidence (MCP registry results were empty); marketplace/community listings may exist outside the fetched sources.
The vendor MCP server endpoint is per-workspace (https://{your-workspace-url}/mcp), so no single published endpoint URL exists.
